skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the activities of businesses, households, and governments in urban economies to maximize profits and benefits.
Ability to search, read, and synthesize scientific information from various sources, apply, analyze, and evaluate basic issues in urban economics.
Capacity to self-study, accumulate experience, and draw conclusions on issues in specialized fields.
Ability to work independently and in groups to solve assigned tasks.
Apply urban economic theories to explain and analyze urban activities in real-world contexts.
Evaluate urban economic theories and apply them to real-world scenarios.
Behavioral decision-making in urban contexts, optimizing benefits and profits for households and businesses.
Effective presentation and communication of urban economic concepts and findings.
Manage time effectively to complete group projects and presentations.
Work collaboratively with peers to achieve group goals.
